name: Outline
description: Fast, beautiful wiki for teams: real-time collaborative docs, nested collections, Markdown support, powerful search.
compose:
services:
  outline:
    image: outlinewiki/outline:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:3000"
    environment:
      SECRET_KEY: "${{cfg.secret_key}}"
      UTILS_SECRET: "${{cfg.secret_key}}"
      URL: "https://${{cfg.domain}}"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/outline/data
    restart: unless-stopped
